Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1070
Claimant:
Michael Castaneda
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
7-8-23
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while
stopped at a traffic signal. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the
attorney's office.
8-15-23
Reviewed the police report, which confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. Statements from two
independent witnesses and the other driver match the account given at first notice, and scene photographs are
consistent with the reported sequence of events.
8-21-23
Vehicle inspection completed. The damage to the rear bumper, trunk, and tail lamp assembly is largely in line with the
described impact speed and direction. No prior damage to the vehicle is recorded or reported, and nothing suggests
the damage predates the policy effective period. The driver is confirmed as a named driver on the policy.
9-6-23
Medical records received from the claimant's treating provider. The reported shoulder injury fits well with the kind and
force of this crash. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from prior records or the claimant's history.
10-15-23
Counsel's office provided treatment summary. Care followed a typical course of physical therapy and follow-up visits,
tapering as the claimant improved. The claimant has given the same account of events in every conversation with the
adjuster to date.
11-29-23
Reviewed the file for the current stage of the claim. Liability and injury information are consistent across all sources,
and the file is ready for evaluation of the bodily injury and property damgae components.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
